title: Entrepreneurship 101
description: Introduction to entrepreneurship with idea validation, lean startup methodology, MVP development, and customer discovery.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations
modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for Entrepreneurship 101.

content.text: Welcome to Lesson 1 of Entrepreneurship 101. In this lesson, you'll learn about Business Fundamentals—a fundamental concept in Business.
Core Concept: Business Fundamentals
Every great entrepreneurship 101 practitioner starts with understanding Business Fundamentals. This lesson walks you through the key ideas, common mistakes, and a practical example you can try today.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: The most successful practitioners in Business always practice Business Fundamentals before moving to more advanced topics.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Business Fundamentals without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main purpose of Business Fundamentals in Entrepreneurship 101?
content.explanation: The goal of Business Fundamentals is to build a solid foundation you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Business Fundamentals to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
